state.reviewType: JEV v3 initial plan_validity checkpoint; plan-only review before Phase 2 implementation.
state.planText: Phase 2 — Browser Mode harness / runtime operations (pre-implementation; no CI/GitHub Actions workflow changes). Preserve all Phase1 paths: `pnpm test` remains happy-dom and excludes browser specs; `pnpm test:browser` uses `vitest.browser.config.ts`; `test:full`/full pre-push run test:all then test:browser; changed pre-push runs Browser Mode after valid non-empty related tests, uses one full fallback for empty/invalid/indeterminate selection, and skips related tests plus Browser Mode for docs/assets-only changes. The hook does not install browsers automatically. Add `tests/browser-mode/setup.ts` for shared per-test React cleanup and reset of DOM/theme attributes, localStorage, JavaScript-visible cookies, and mock call/spy state; add a focused same-file sequential isolation spec. Add only a small shared render/fixture helper for currently used capabilities, deferring provider-wrapper abstraction until needed. Demonstrate `userEvent` from `vitest/browser` alongside locator interaction and async `expect.element`; avoid native ESM namespace `vi.spyOn`; keep real blocking dialogs in Playwright or explicitly mock only the API. Treat isolation as per file and reset state each test. Record manually installed Chromium / Linux dependencies, preserve `fileParallelism=true`, two workers, 5s action timeout, no retry, failure trace/screenshots/DOM snapshots, and invocation-to-exit cold/warm timings including startup. Update OpenSpec WHEN/THEN scenarios in parallel. Accept when shared helper, same-file sequential isolation for DOM/theme/storage/cookie/mock state, userEvent plus locator/async assertions, runtime settings/artifacts/timing, existing happy-dom/test:full/pre-push paths intact, and OpenSpec synced. All 33 current MAP-ineligible IDs remain deferred for individual Phase 5 investigation.
existingProjectFacts: Phase 1 was accepted by a direct TypeSafe checkpoint as valid_as_defined after final local verification; its report is under results/plan45/phase1/. Phase 1 did not perform an external push and bounds its claim to local/pre-push gates.

Current vitest.browser.config.ts uses @vitest/browser-playwright, Vitest Browser Mode, Chromium headless at 1280x800, browser specs under tests/browser-mode, fileParallelism=true and maxWorkers=2; package.json and lockfile pin Vitest/provider 4.1.11.

Current vitest.config.ts defaults to happy-dom and excludes tests/browser-mode/**. package.json defines test:browser and test:full; pre-push retains changed/full test selection and Browser Mode gating.
Current ThemeToggle browser tests provide existing component-render/locator and computed CSS examples. Phase2 harness items are not implemented yet.
existingSpecEvidence: openspec/specs/nextjstest/spec.md has operational scenarios for default Vitest suite isolation; Browser Mode scope; pre-push validation; manual install; empty/invalid/indeterminate fallback exactly once; failure stop; and hook smoke validation.
OpenSpec explicitly states Browser Mode does not establish Next production route/SSR/Flight/hydration; local pre-push is the enforcement path. User says no GitHub Actions workflow changes.
officialVitestEvidence: https://vitest.dev/guide/browser/ : native browser execution with window/document; provider required and Playwright provider setup documented.
https://vitest.dev/config/browser/playwright : one page for all tests in a file and a fresh Playwright context per file, not per test; grounds same-file state reset work.
https://vitest.dev/api/browser/interactivity : userEvent is provider-backed CDP/WebDriver interaction; keyboard state resets but pointer/hover state may persist within a file.
https://vitest.dev/api/browser/context : browser context APIs and userEvent export documented.

Version caveat: repository pins Vitest/provider 4.1.11. Current vitest.dev pages are rolling docs and v4.vitest.dev identifies the major version, not exact 4.1.11 patch. Treat exact compatibility as a Phase2 implementation verification item; do not claim moving docs alone proves patch-specific behavior.
explicitBoundaries: User confirmed local pre-push enforcement is sufficient; do not require or add GitHub Actions/CI workflow changes.
Phase2 is pre-implementation; its planned harness/runtime tasks are not implemented or accepted yet.
Phase5 must investigate all 33 current MAP-ineligible stable IDs individually. Do not treat them as final exclusions, change denominator, or expand Phase2 scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Phase2 deliverables are specific, testable, internally consistent with current Browser Mode provider lifecycle and package version caveat.
Shared cleanup/helper and same-file isolation acceptance reflects one page/context per file and only promises reset of JS-accessible state.
userEvent, locator and expect.element requirements are supported by official cited API.
Runtime/install/artifact/timing requirements, pre-push preservation, OpenSpec synchronization and Phase5 deferral are consistent.

outputProtocol.requiredVerdict: Choose exactly one of the eight labels in questions.plan_validity.criteria; only valid_as_defined passes.
outputProtocol.diagnosis: Also choose a finding, affected location/requirement, evidence assessment, immediate next action and remaining uncertainty. If valid, choose no_case_specific_finding and none rather than inventing a defect.
outputProtocol.conditionalClarification: If initial valid API response selects any verdict other than valid_as_defined, including indeterminate, preserve initial choice and complete probability distribution; create at least two mutually exclusive case-specific immediate action options. Each must target exactly one of code, plan, OpenSpec, or evidence-only; all must carry the same initial finding, affected location, evidence/neededEvidence. Send exactly one follow-up requiring selected choice ID, concrete finding, affected path/requirement, observed evidence or exact neededEvidence, specific nextAction/proposedFix, and remainingUncertainty (state none explicitly if none). Preserve initial decision summary/distribution and set effectiveVerdict=require_revalidation. If any required diagnostic details are missing, record resolution=unresolved, diagnosisStatus=incomplete, unresolvedReasons. Do not chain. Initial transport/schema failure: no follow-up; record error/unresolved.

plan_validity.instructions: Is the pre-implementation Phase 2 plan valid as defined? Only valid_as_defined is passing.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The pre-implementation Phase 2 plan is valid and internally consistent as defined; its deliverables, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and boundaries are sufficiently concrete and compatible with existing specs and official Vitest capabilities.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: The Phase 2 requirements conflict with each other, an existing OpenSpec requirement, or the user-approved project boundary; identify the concrete conflict.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: A material prerequisite or decision is missing from the plan and prevents Phase 2 from being safely/reproducibly started; state the specific missing fact.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The review cannot be completed because information about the existing Phase 1 implementation/configuration is missing. Do not select this merely because Phase 2 has not yet been implemented; this is explicitly a plan checkpoint.
criteria.implementation_issue: Existing Phase 1 code/configuration evidence exposes a concrete implementation issue that blocks the Phase 2 plan as written.
criteria.scope_violation: The Phase 2 plan violates explicit boundaries: local pre-push is sufficient, no GitHub Actions/CI workflow changes, and all 33 current MAP-ineligible IDs must be investigated individually in Phase 5 rather than excluded conclusively here.
criteria.other: A different, concrete plan blocker exists; identify the affected requirement and evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied plan and evidence do not support either acceptance or a concrete rejection.

case_finding.instructions: Select the strongest case-specific diagnosis supported by the plan and evidence. A valid plan selects no_case_specific_finding.

criteria.no_case_specific_finding: No material Phase 2 plan defect; it can proceed as described.
criteria.setup_cleanup_contract: The proposed per-test DOM/theme/storage/cookie/mock reset is underspecified or incorrect for Vitest Browser Mode lifecycle.
criteria.shared_helper_scope: Shared render helper scope is too broad, premature, or unclear.
criteria.user_event_contract: Supported Vitest Browser Mode userEvent/locator/expect.element behavior or a state-persistence caveat is misrepresented.
criteria.runtime_artifact_contract: Runtime, retries, browser install, trace/screenshot, cold/warm timing acceptance is missing, contradictory, or not measurable.
criteria.prepush_or_ci_scope: The plan improperly changes or weakens established local pre-push paths or requests CI/GitHub Actions contrary to user instruction.
criteria.phase5_scope: The plan treats the 33 MAP-ineligible scenarios as final exclusions or pulls their per-ID investigation into Phase 2.
criteria.spec_sync: The OpenSpec update deliverable does not accurately reflect Phase 2 acceptance/boundaries.
criteria.version_evidence: The plan relies on current unversioned Vitest docs as exact 4.1.11 proof without a compatibility caveat or verification requirement.

affected_requirement.instructions: Which exact path, Phase2 item or user boundary is affected? Select none only when there is no material finding.

criteria.plan_phase2_lifecycle: Plan Phase 2 same-file isolation and tests/browser-mode/setup.ts requirements.
criteria.plan_phase2_interaction: Plan Phase 2 userEvent, locator interaction and expect.element requirements.
criteria.plan_phase2_operations: Plan Phase 2 runtime, timeout/retry, browser prerequisite, artifact and timing requirements.
criteria.phase1_existing_config: vitest.browser.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, package.json and existing Browser Mode specs.
criteria.user_boundary: User-confirmed local pre-push-only enforcement; no GitHub Actions/CI workflow modification.
criteria.phase5_inventory: Explicit requirement to investigate each of the 33 current MAP-ineligible stable IDs in Phase 5.
criteria.other_location: Another exact file/requirement identified from supplied facts.

evidence_assessment.instructions: Do the plan and cited evidence support acceptance, or is there a concrete evidentiary gap/conflict?

criteria.evidence_sufficient_and_consistent: Plan and existing code/spec facts support the Phase 2 scope; relevant current official Vitest docs are linked and any version mismatch is expressly treated as a verification caveat.
criteria.isolation_lifecycle_not_grounded: The requirement to reset page/context state is not sufficiently grounded in the provider lifecycle evidence.
criteria.user_event_capability_not_grounded: The planned userEvent demonstration or locator/async assertions are not supported by the cited provider/API facts.
criteria.version_compatibility_unknown: The official pages are current/unversioned and do not prove exact Vitest 4.1.11 behavior; this is a blocking evidence gap rather than an implementation conclusion.
criteria.prepush_scope_conflict: Plan text conflicts with the stated pre-push-only/no-GitHub-Actions boundary.
criteria.phase5_deferral_conflict: Plan text conflicts with the Phase5 per-ID investigation of all 33 current ineligible IDs.
criteria.specific_requirement_conflict: A specific Phase 2 requirement conflicts with another cited requirement.
criteria.evidence_insufficient: The supplied evidence cannot resolve a material question.

immediate_next_action.instructions: Choose the immediate next action. If valid, continue Phase2 as planned; preserve pre-push and Phase5 boundaries.

criteria.continue_phase2_as_planned: Proceed with the Phase 2 plan as written; implement only its harness/runtime deliverables, keep local pre-push paths intact, and leave all 33 IDs for Phase 5.
criteria.change_phase2_plan_only: Revise only the Phase 2 plan text to fix the identified requirement/prerequisite issue; do not change code/spec or collect additional evidence in this action.
criteria.change_openspec_only: Revise only the relevant OpenSpec WHEN/THEN text to fix the identified mismatch; do not change implementation/plan or collect additional evidence in this action.
criteria.implement_existing_phase1_only: Change only existing Phase 1 implementation/configuration to fix the concrete blocker; do not revise plan/spec or collect other evidence in this action.
criteria.collect_versioned_evidence_only: Collect only the exact version-pinned/provider lifecycle evidence required; do not change code, plan, or spec in this action.
criteria.hold_for_scope_decision: Hold only because a concrete conflict in explicit user/project scope requires a decision.

remaining_uncertainty.instructions: What uncertainty remains for this plan-only checkpoint? Operational checks explicitly scheduled for Phase2 are not blockers unless they prevent the plan from being started.

criteria.none_for_plan_checkpoint: No remaining blocking uncertainty for starting Phase 2 as a plan; unresolved operational checks remain explicitly Phase 2 acceptance work.
criteria.vitest_411_compatibility: Exact compatibility of one or more cited current docs statements with pinned Vitest 4.1.11 is unresolved.
criteria.state_reset_mechanics: Exact same-file/browser-context reset mechanism or cookie/state persistence is unresolved.
criteria.runtime_trace_value: Trace Viewer diagnostic value/artifact behavior is not yet demonstrated; determine whether the plan treats it as required vs follow-up.
criteria.external_push: No external push was performed; determine whether this affects a pre-implementation Phase 2 plan (not Phase 1 local gate).
criteria.plan_acceptance_detail: A specific acceptance item remains too ambiguous to implement or verify.
criteria.phase5_deferral: The Phase 5 deferral or 33-ID scope remains unclear.
